topic: Adjusting frequency model for specific city
summary_markdown:
The initial issue with the screen report was addressed and confirmed as fixed. A discussion followed regarding adjusting the frequency model for a single city (Porto Alegre) belonging to company 7887 in Brazil.

It was determined that while adjustment is possible, it cannot be done using the ml-api because the frequency feature for company 7887 has not been released on that platform. To proceed with testing, someone suggested providing a multiplier formula for staging environment testing.
decisions: The screen report fix was confirmed as working.
action_items: Provide the necessary SQL formula/logic to test frequency adjustments in the staging environment.
